Pepper Pike Local Knowledge

Pepper Pike's 24-Inch Tree Removal Permit

Pepper Pike requires a village-issued permit for the removal of any tree measuring 24 inches DBH (diameter at breast height, ~4.5 ft up the trunk) or larger. Roubic handles the entire permit process in-house — including village submission, plan-of-work documentation, and closeout — as part of the estimate scope. There is no separate homeowner filing burden.

Trees under 24" DBH do not require a Pepper Pike permit for private-property removal, though tree-lawn (right-of-way) trees are handled separately by the village.

Included in every Pepper Pike removal estimate at no additional cost

What Happens If You Defer

The Cost of Waiting — Pepper Pike Context

Three scenarios that turn a $700 removal into a $3,000 emergency job.

EAB Ash Stability Degradation

Standing dead ash goes from stable to compromised in a single growing season. Pepper Pike lost most of its ash 2010–2014 — the remaining dead trees are the fragile ones.

Wind-Load Failures

Pepper Pike's mature estate canopy takes hard wind hits every March–May. Leaning or dead-crown trees near garages become insurance-deductible events.

Village Right-of-Way Fines

Trees threatening Pepper Pike right-of-way can generate village citation letters if left unremediated after notice. Removal cost stays the same; the fine is added.

Common Pepper Pike Removal Questions

Pepper Pike Tree Removal FAQ

Six things Pepper Pike homeowners want to know before booking.

Do I need a permit to remove a tree in Pepper Pike?
Yes — Pepper Pike requires a village permit for the removal of any tree 24 inches DBH (diameter at breast height, measured ~4.5 ft up the trunk) or larger. Roubic handles the permit filing on your behalf as part of the estimate scope — including village submission, plan-of-work documentation, and closeout. No homeowner paperwork burden. Trees under 24" DBH do not require permits for private-property removal in Pepper Pike.
How fast can Roubic remove a tree in Pepper Pike?
Pepper Pike is a Tier 1 Roubic service area — priority estimate scheduling during business hours (Mon–Fri 7am–6pm) and 1–2 hour on-site response for after-hours storm / emergency calls via our 24/7 line. Standard removals are typically scheduled within 1 week of estimate approval; emergency work runs priority.
How much does tree removal cost in Pepper Pike?
Aaron's confirmed 2026 pricing applies: small tree under 30 ft $400–$700; medium 30–60 ft $700–$1,400; large 60–80 ft $1,200–$2,200 (Pepper Pike estate access sometimes pushes the higher end); very-large or crane-required $2,000–$5,000+. Village permit filing is included in the price. Every estimate is free on-site.
Does Roubic handle estate properties in Pepper Pike?
Yes — Pepper Pike estate work has been Roubic's specialty since 1982. Aaron owns and operates the equipment, personally walks every estimate, and the tenured field crew (10-year foreman Doug Battiest) protects specimen trees and landscaping during removal work. ANSI A300 pruning standards apply to any preservation-side work.
Are you insured for Pepper Pike tree removal jobs?
Yes — Roubic carries general liability insurance and workers-compensation coverage. Certificate of insurance available on request and included in the estimate packet for jobs requiring COI submission (common for property-manager estates and HOA work in Pepper Pike).
Can Roubic handle crane-required removals in Pepper Pike?
Yes — for very-large trees (80+ ft) or removals over structures where standard rigging isn't feasible, Roubic coordinates crane access on-site. This is common on Pepper Pike estate properties where narrow drives limit equipment access. Pricing starts at $2,000 for crane-assisted removals; scope confirmed during the free estimate walk.
